sentences.text: Hi, Andrew.
Hi, Rachel.
How you doing?
I'm good.
How are you?
Can you hear and see me?
I can.
This meeting is being recorded.
I can hear you.
Let's have a look.
Let me see.
Let me just turn on and off my camera again.
Yeah, you're kind of blurred, but you're there.
Apologies.
Give me one.
There we go.
There we go.
There you go.
Hi, how are you?
I'm good, thank you.
I'm good.
Yeah, nice to meet you too.
Yes.
So I'm calling from Kuala Lumpur at the moment.
From where, sorry?
Malaysia.
Oh, from Malaysia.
Ah, okay.
Brilliant.
Yes, yes.
Thank you so much for taking time to jump the call with me today.
Yeah, no problem, Not a problem.
The way these calls usually work.
Just here really, just to get an idea of what it is that you guys are doing and obviously how we can help you.
I don't know how much you know about Capital A.
Excuse me?
Don't know how much you know about capital A, but we're an M and A advisory for marketing services companies.
So we work pretty much exclusively in marketing services.
We also work on the buy and the sell side and our platform Agencies CO is a marketplace for agency owners to buy and sell agency businesses.
So we tend to work with mostly sort of growing agencies on the buy side and private equity and on the sell side with agency owners who are looking to sell.
That's great.
That's fantastic.
It fits into what we're looking to do.
Oh, brilliant.
Okay.
Yeah.
So I didn't know whether you were looking to buy agencies yourself because on one of the forms you filled in, you put that it was for something else, not not buying or selling.
But it'd be good to hear about what it is that you're doing.
Yeah, so I.
I must have clicked that wrongly.
But so we are looking to buy agencies.
So right now we are looking to build a unique kind of creative group to solve client problems and business problems that is in the video gaming space.
So.
Because right now we are seeing a significant opportunity for us to establish ourselves in this niche as we see that there is a lack of agency dedicated exclusively to this space.
So right now we are looking to acquire agencies with the services that my partner and I believe could fit our group in a very positive way.
And you know, I came across capital A and which is why I wanted to reach out to see if you're representing any agencies that are looking to sell.
Okay.
Yep.
So we do.
As I said, we've got the agencies CO platform where we represent sellers directly.
So we get to know more about what it is that you're exactly looking for.
So we've worked in the gaming space quite a bit over the years, so we have quite a good network in gaming.
Is it, is it particularly in the US or UK or is it in Malaysia that you're looking to acquire?
US and uk?

Predominantly in the UK itself, we are looking for agencies that, agencies and studios that, you know, are gaming focused, that all have experience with the gaming and entertainment space or you know, we understand that there could sometimes be because of this niche of the, that that we're targeting.
So we're also looking at agencies that might have services that could be cross utilized to, you know, the gaming and entertainment space.
Okay, so what is it, what this, what are they sort of skill sets that you're looking to acquire?
A variety.
Launching.
Launching games.
New games.
Yeah, so launching new games, social media, you know, influencer marketing media, buying game game 2D, 3D, art design, you know, a bunch of it.
So yeah, currently we are in formation stage at the moment.
So we are at a stage where we are assessing targets in the industry and you know, trying to get one across the line as quickly as we can.
Okay, so whereabouts are you as a business at the moment?
Are you already set up and running?
Do you have agencies already that you're, you're working?
No, we're currently in formation stage.
Information.
Okay.
And then in terms of how you're capitalized, what's, what's the sort of structure of the business?
Is there investors that are coming in or, or you know, how is it set up?
They're sort of true bank financing as well as alternative lenders.
Okay, okay, so that's ready to go, is it?
No, we, we are not looking to raise a blindfold.
We're going to fund these on a deal by deal basis.
So depending on the merits and numbers of that particular deal, then get it funded.
But you know, we already have a couple of financial institutions already in the pipeline that are interested and they're just waiting for us to bring a deal to them.
Okay, well I know how these work then.
So the bit, the bigger the deal the better.
But I'm going to ask you what kind of, what size deals that you're looking for.
Do you have like sort of a size in mind in terms of revenue, ebitda, size of the deal and the size of the team as well.

So preferably we like the, the company to have revenue of at least £1,000,000, one to £10,000,000, or a minimum of around 250,000 EBITDA they have to be operating for at least three years and have a minimum of four employees.
Okay, cool.
All right.
So we're not, as far as I know, representing any gaming companies at the moment, but we know a lot of gaming companies.
We've worked on the buy side a couple of different times with gaming companies looking to acquire and acquire in businesses in the UK in particular.
Also in Germany we did quite a bit of activity.
But certainly in the UK we know a number of companies that are considering selling.
So we can definitely reach out to them and see what their situation is at the moment.
How is your business set up?
I can see on the website there's like a few of you already in the business.
So Mark, yourself and Ian, are you actively, you know, sort of searching for deals at the moment?
Yes.
Yeah.

So just in terms of the way that your team is set up, because obviously some teams just reach out to brokers, whereas others are sort of actively reaching out to all companies that match their criteria.

The reason why I'm asking is because we offer this service in the uk, like I say we do this, we actually do it in the UK and the us working with buy side clients and helping them to build a pipeline of deals so that they can get on with getting the deals done and getting the offers out and we can build that deal flow for you.
Is that something that you're looking for?
Are you already good the way that you're set up?
So currently we're already good in the way that we are set up.
We're just trying to expand the net as much as we can really.
Right now we're information stage and we haven't really incorporated the company because incorporating and determining the entity structure will depend on the size and the size of the deal.
So we're going to wait until we're closer to the first deal to incorporate the company.
Okay, cool.
Yeah.
Because we work with a lot of investors like yourself that are looking to make that first investment, but they're not set up with a sort of agency business.
And we can help bring those discussions to the table much quicker, obviously, because we're quite well known in the space, so we can bring a bit of credibility to the initial conversations.
But that's all good.
That's all good.

What I'll do is I'll go back to my team, we've got an update tomorrow morning or midday, I think, and we'll go through your criteria and see if we've got anything on the radar that we can bring to you and see if There's a conversation to be had but certainly we'll make a note of your, your details and I'll put you on our mailing list as well.
So the next time we do update our, our own portfolio that you'll be able to be contacted immediately for that as well.
Awesome.
That sounds perfect.

I just wanted to understand a bit more because you mentioned about, you know, your buy side, how, how does it work in terms of, you know, from onboarding, you know, what is the fees you charge for, you know, from us.
Yeah.
So the way it works, it's usually sort of a six month project that we're looking at.
It takes about two or three weeks to get up and running.
But once we are, we're able to reach out to bespoke list of targets for our clients.
We usually bring something like I would say sort of three to six each week and those are screened as well.
So we've already spoken to them that they're legitimate sellers, they're interested in speaking with, with the client, etc.
And obviously that's quite sort of intense in the first few months.

But once we've got a few deals on the table, then the process really is about, you know, requesting financials and getting into those second conversations and getting offers on the table, sort of helping to negotiate those deals.
So usually we get a deal closed within about six months.
We work with several clients that come back, you know, over time.
And to do second and third transactions, we actually work with a company called Skyview.
We're, we're about to close the third and fourth deals with them.
The first two deals we did in about eight months.
So that's kind of a sort of standard way of, of, of of us working.
But I can get that in an email to Rachel, put that in an email.
You can discuss with your business partners whether that's something that you would be looking to do.
Give you a bit more information on that.
Yeah, that would be most helpful.
Thank you very much.
In terms of the cost.
Sorry, I did mess up.
The cost here is $5,000 a month and we take one and a half percent on the deal as well.
So there are two flavors actually that we can do it, we can do it without taking a percent on the deal, but we don't do the screening calls.
We just, we do all of the outreach for you and manage the whole thing through like an inbox which you can then manage yourself.
So we'll set up the calls and we can request information but we don't actually do any of the Actual calls themselves.
So we do that for $5,000 and we don't take a cut.
But you just don't get that next step where we're doing the actual screening calls as well, which is a bit more in depth.
Okay, understood.
And do you work with success fees?
Yeah, sorry.
So the success fee, if we're involved in the screening and we're actually bringing those deals in for you, then we take one and a half percent on the success fee, on the win fee.
Yeah.
So in order to get started, we would have to pay a retainer first, either way.
Yeah.
We always work on a retained basis.
Yeah.
I mean, we're good at what we do.
Got quite a good case studies document that we can send out.
And we've got a good reputation, very good reputation in the UK and the US for doing what we do on the buy side.
Okay, yeah.
If you can share some information, but that would be fantastic.
Yeah, I'll send some over and then you can talk to your partners if it's something that you can afford straight off the bat.
Not everybody can if you've not raised the capital yet.
But we can accelerate this process, you know, crush it right down from 24 months to 6 months to get your first deal done, if that's what you're looking to do.
Okay, understood.
Yeah, that'd be great.
Awesome.
I think that's it.
From my side.
Do you have any additional questions for me?
I think that's it.
Really.
That's pretty much it.
I mean, let's stay connected on email, unless you're interested in.
I was doing the buy side search for you, but certainly we will have something come up over the next month or two, I should imagine, and we'll be in touch.
Yeah, that'd be fantastic.
If you do come across any, please do keep me in mind.
Yeah, definitely.
All right, Have a great day, Rachel.
You too.
Have a great day.
Thank you.
Cheers.
By the record.

summary.overview: In the Business Development and Client Onboarding meeting between Rachel Lai and Andy Day, Rachel, calling from Kuala Lumpur, outlined her objectives to acquire agencies focused on video gaming for a new creative group targeting the US and UK markets, seeking firms with relevant services and specific characteristics such as a revenue range of £1-10 million and a minimum of four employees. Andy, representing Capital A, an M&A advisory firm, described their services which include building deal pipelines specifically for Rachel’s buy-side search by presenting screened acquisition targets over a typical six-month engagement. The meeting concluded with agreed action items, where Andy would share detailed information and case studies about Capital A's offerings, while Rachel would discuss her buy-side strategy with her partners.
summary.short_summary: Rachel Lai, calling from Kuala Lumpur, outlined her objective to acquire agencies focused on video gaming to build a unique creative group targeting the US and UK markets. She is looking for firms with a revenue range of £1-10 million, a minimum EBITDA of £250,000, and at least four employees. Andy Day, representing Capital A, an M&A advisory firm, elaborated on their services, which include building deal pipelines for Rachel's buy-side search by presenting screened acquisition targets over a typical six-month engagement. They agreed that Andy would provide detailed information and case studies about Capital A's offerings, while Rachel would discuss her buy-side strategy with her partners.
